translations.web: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
translations.bsb: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
translations.kjv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
translations.asv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.
